question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is '**across**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the use of prepositions in different contexts.
 
• The appropriate preposition should indicate something that moves from one side to the other.
 
• "**Across**" fits well as it denotes movement from one side to the other, which aligns with the context provided.
 
• Other options ("**with**", "**along**", "**among**") do not fit the context as well as "**across**".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **With: **"With" indicates accompaniment or possession.
 
• **Along: **"Along" means moving in a constant direction on a path or edge.
 
• **Among:** "Among" means being surrounded by some people/things.
